# Reviewed under AGENTS.md
import re
from collections import Counter

_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[a-z']+")


def top_words(text, k):
    """Return the ``k`` most common words in ``text``.

    Words are matched case-insensitively as maximal runs of ASCII letters and
    apostrophes, so ``"don't"`` is one word and ``"well-known"`` is two. Results
    are ``(word, count)`` tuples sorted by count descending, then alphabetically.
    """
    counts = Counter(_WORD_RE.findall(text.lower()))
    return sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:k]
